name: Jürgen Peter
dirt_evidence: Home-built fuzz box used by The Haunted on “1-2-5”
notes: Robert Burgess's historical account explicitly identifies Jürgen Peter as the person who built the homemade fuzz box used by Al Birmingham during the 1966 recording of “1-2-5”. This is a verified dirt-making act, but not evidence of a commercial pedal company. Preserve as an individual custom-builder node, distinct from The Haunted as a band.
